summary: Iteration 73 — Backend Remix + Frontend Remix UI + Private LIVE end-to-end (host + viewer via 2 contexts). Backend: 5/5 remix tests PASS (test_iteration73_remix.py). Frontend Remix: reel-remix-btn + reel-remix-sheet (Dúo/Stitch + Ver N remixes) work; reel-remix-label on a remix reel opens reel-remixes-sheet with items; RemixStudio Stitch opens with remix-trim + start/end sliders + next (no remix-error). Frontend LIVE HOST: /lives/start flow works end-to-end (title input, live-visibility-private, live-go-btn -> live-host-page, live-access-code=6 chars, live-host-video with fake camera videoWidth=1280 readyState=4, live-close-btn closes and redirects to /lives). Frontend LIVE VIEWER: /lives/join?code=CODE correctly redirects to /lives/<id>?code=CODE and auto-shows live-viewer-page; privacy-shield/privacy-watermark/privacy-badge all render; privacy-blackout appears on visibilitychange->hidden+blur and clears on focus. HOWEVER: on the viewer side the LIVE WS signaling (/api/lives/<id>/ws) is NEVER opened — captured ws opens are only /ws and /ws/chat/<token>. Consequently: remote-video.srcObject stays null (no WebRTC media), host live-viewer-count remains 0, host live-events empty (no 'se unió'), viewer comments do not appear in host events (and vice-versa), viewer hearts do not float on host, and the live_ended broadcast never reaches the viewer (viewer URL does NOT navigate to /lives when host closes).

integration_issues.issue: On the viewer side the live-signaling WebSocket to /api/lives/<liveId>/ws is never opened after auto-joining via /lives/join?code=CODE. Playwright captured only /ws and /ws/chat/<token> ws opens on the viewer page; no /api/lives/<id>/ws. As a result: live-remote-video.srcObject remains null (no WebRTC track received), host live-viewer-count stays 0, host live-events is empty (no 'se unió' event), viewer's live-comment-send does NOT propagate to host live-events (and vice-versa), viewer hearts do NOT show as floating .live-heart on host, and when the host clicks live-close-btn the viewer is NOT navigated to /lives (no live_ended WS event received). Host-side WS to /api/lives/<id>/ws WAS observed opening (host camera works and code UI renders). Likely a bug in useLiveRTC on the viewer path (perhaps aborts when there is no local stream or waits for a stream that never comes, or the access_code / token is not being forwarded on the viewer WS URL). This blocks the entire private-live two-party experience.

action_items: Investigate why the viewer side of /pages/LiveViewerPage.jsx + hooks/useLiveRTC.js never opens the /api/lives/<liveId>/ws WebSocket. Repro: log in as any non-host user, visit /lives/join?code=<CODE> for a private live created by another host; page renders live-viewer-page but no WS is opened (Playwright browser.on('websocket') sees only /ws and /ws/chat/<token>). Fix should ensure the viewer opens the signaling WS with ?token=<jwt>&code=<CODE> immediately when live-viewer-page mounts, independent of getUserMedia (viewer does not need a local camera).

After fix, re-run the two-context private-live flow: expect host live-viewer-count -> 1, host live-events to receive 'se unió' + viewer comments + hearts, viewer live-events to receive its own + host echoes, and viewer navigation to /lives on host live-close-btn.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend remix endpoints fully covered by /app/backend/tests/test_iteration73_remix.py (5/5). The Remix UI (sheets + RemixStudio open) works; the recording step could not be exercised because mcp_browser_automation does not accept custom chromium args (no --use-fake-device-for-media-stream) — publish path requires manual verification or a runner with fake media flags. Private-live HOST works; the VIEWER shows page + privacy but does NOT open /api/lives/<id>/ws, so no WebRTC/media/comments/hearts. Priority for main agent: check LiveViewerPage/useLiveRTC WS opener. Iteration 72 backend WS tests still pass, so the server relay is fine — this is a frontend viewer-side bug.
rca_of_the_issue: Viewer-side private-live signaling WS is never opened. Captured websocket URLs on the viewer page: [wss://.../ws, wss://.../ws/chat/<token>] — no wss://.../api/lives/<liveId>/ws. Effects cascade: no viewer_joined -> host viewer-count=0 -> no offer/answer exchange -> live-remote-video.srcObject=null. Suggested fix: in LiveViewerPage.jsx (or useLiveRTC.js), ensure the WS is opened unconditionally when live-viewer-page mounts (post-join with a valid code), passing ?token=<jwt>&code=<CODE>, and do NOT gate the WS open on getUserMedia success (viewer is receive-only).
